label: Multilingual v2 post-remediation regression on previously observed challenge set
methods: 362 identical semantic envelopes retain historical assessments under the unchanged canonical database; all 38 changed responses received post-freeze primary and fresh R11 review.

R11 checked the saved data of all 28 ok replies against canonical data via read-only SQL; 22 are bounded goal completions, four are honest partial lists and two remain wrong-operation recognition failures.
Two invalid-clock cases were reclassified from legitimate clarification to recognition failure because their actual multiple_goals reason fails to recognize the malformed clock.
Individual challenge content was accessed only after the committed source freeze; no behavioral tuning, checkpoint selection or further challenge run followed.
HTTP success, intent-label agreement and source preflight are not general accuracy. Correct fare data with extraneous route metadata is recorded as a separate defect.
